sources.title: Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air · 0.6B — Listening Demo
sources.snippet: Listen to Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air: expressive speech in a compact 0.6B model, with 23 supported languages. Explore 24 examples alongside Preview, Breeze-TTS-2, Qwen3-TTS and Higgs TTS 3.

sources.title: TechnoBaptist/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Audio8-TTS-Realistic-Air builds on Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6b, delivering substantially improved speech realism while retaining its compact 0.6B architecture and zero-shot voice cloning capabilities. This release supports 23 languages, adding 12 languages compared with Preview. It uses the same Transformers inference interface as Preview.
